item.title: Chronic fly tipping, 20th September
item.description:
The fly tipping in the swan mead area is chronic and constant. there is both constant fly tipping and overflowing waste bins. Clearly, on the side of the street, someone has just cleared out a house and dumbed all the belongings there without even bothering to put many of the clothes into bags. its disguishing. The refuse chutes have also overflown, i assume because the same person has dumped a lot of waste into the chutes. this is presumably a landlord or someone clearing out an abaonded house with belongings still in them. its unacceptable and CCTV must be installed to stop this behaviour. every few weeks there is major cases of fly tipping here

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Leroy Street, Walworth, Greater London
